subtitle: Nine boards. One big win.
description:
Tic tac toe, with a twist.

Every move matters in Ultimate Tic/Tac/Toe. Play on nine small boards at once. The square you choose sends your opponent to their next board. Win three small boards in a row to claim the bigger game.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Practice against three levels of computer opponent.
• Challenge a friend online with Game Center turn-based matches and rematches.
• Play together on one iPhone with pass-and-play.

GET BETTER
• Learn the rules with a short interactive tutorial.
• Follow the winning lines and replay finished games.
• Track wins, streaks and results by difficulty.
• Earn Game Center achievements and compare online victories.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose light, dark or automatic appearance.
• Turn sound effects and haptics on or off.
• Play for free, with an optional one-time purchase to remove banner ads.

One board is never enough.
